For undisclosed vulnerabilities use [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/edgeforge-suite/EdgeForgeStudio/blob/main/SECURITY.md),
not this template. Use synthetic examples and redacted diagnostics only.

## Authoring problem

Who encounters it, in which supported flow, and what is the current workaround?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the smallest useful change and how its result can be observed.

## Contract and scope

- Relevant Studio/Engine versions, archetype and local/shared mode:
- Which existing interface, mapping, rule or handoff is involved?
- Does this require a paired Engine change or an auth/security design decision?
- Prerequisites and explicit exclusions:

## Completion evidence

What synthetic example and checks would show the change works? Link an existing
issue/design if one already owns the work. A request does not authorize a new
contract, release, support commitment or implementation scope.
